title: Guterres urges faster action and financing to stop biodiversity loss
keyFacts: The United Nations Secretary-General appealed on Friday for governments, businesses and communities to accelerate efforts to protect biodiversity for future generations and all life on Earth.

title: Could your brain data be used against you? UN calls for limits on neurotechnology
keyFacts: Brain signals recorded by a gaming headset or a wellness gadget could one day be used as evidence against you in court, according to a new UN report which warns that neurotechnology is outpacing the laws meant to protect human rights.

title: The world is waging a ‘war on nature’ as progress on biodiversity targets lags
keyFacts: Fewer than half of the national targets set to protect the world’s plants, animals and ecosystems are on track, the UN warns in a new report, days before countries gather in Yerevan, Armenia, for the COP17 biodiversity conference.
